coverage_plan.scope: US-listed operating equities and ADRs on verified venues; property and mortgage entities remain entities. Macro/ETF gauges remain references.

evidence.detail: Current instrument scope; economic sectors/weights are analyst judgements, not heat or provider-count allocations.
Full 11856-stock scan, incumbents, ADRs and separate reference identities reviewed. Stable economic plan, sector caps, weights and budgets preserved.

sectors.rationale: Semiconductors, enterprise computing and software have separate duties within one restrained parent budget.
Internet distribution, media and network operators retain distinct economic functions.
Deposit banks, credit, payments, insurance and market infrastructure are protected separately.
Drug development, devices, diagnostics, insurance and clinical delivery all retain representatives.
Staples and discretionary demand, including traditional brands and housing, remain visible.
Aerospace, machinery, transport, construction and environmental services retain independent duties.
Upstream, services, midstream and refining are different earnings engines.
Chemicals, metals, building materials and packaging observe different industrial inputs.
Regulated utilities, merchant power and fuel/equipment are distinguished.
Property types and mortgage finance are not collapsed into one generic rate-sensitive proxy.
